title: Muljim Ne Aaj Kaisi Musibat Ye Dhayi
body:
Maula ali…(4)
Masjid e koofa laraz uthi..
kohraam barpa hogaya dono jahaan mein..(2)
Muljim ne aaj kaisi musibat ye dhayi hai
deene rasool e paak ki shamma bujhai hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Masjid me haaye tune namazi ko maar kar..(3)
duniya me kis tarah ki musibat machayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Koofe ki har gali me yehi shoro shayn hai..(3)
muljim ne aaj zarb ali pe lagayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Zakhmi padar ko dekh ke hasnain ro pade..(3)
zainab pukari aye mere nana dohayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Aayi sadaa e ghayb ke maula hue shaheed..(3)
har samt momino pe udaasi si chhayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Koofe ke sab yateem tadapte hai khaak par..(3)
baade saba ne kaisi sunani sunayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Larzi zamee’n husain ke aaho fugha’n ke baad..(3)
zaalim ye tune kaisi qayamat machayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Khoone ali ko dekhe ke roti hai kayenaat..(3)
sajde me rozedaar ne talwaar khaayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Bachho ke bayn sunke malaek bhi ro pade..(3)
roya khuda e paak to royi khudayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Rota qalam hai mera manazir mai kya likhu..(3)
saqlain ke wali pe jo zarbat lagayi hai
deene rasool e paak ki shamma bujhai hai
Maula ali…(4)
